dataset.attrition: All 84 authored answerable questions retained. Six have known graph-only facets; 78 have all known facets directly retrieved, after reviewing alternatives.
dataset.authoring: Fresh relational questions authored before baseline pooling; second batch used multi-facet questions from new anchors after baseline-only screening. No query rewrites and no propagation outcomes before freeze.
dataset.labels: Single-agent known-support labels, exact duplicates and reviewed equivalents. Unjudged candidates are not negatives; facet/source mapping audited before freeze.
dataset.partition: Semantic groups and known positive nodes never cross dev/held-out. Queue/accounting and citation/canonization challenges on dev; caller identity and proxy-recovery challenges held out.
dataset.publication: Raw snapshots, texts, IDs, questions, qrels, vector cache, paths and per-query results remain private outside Git.

decision: No runtime/default change. Tested propagation recovered no held-out missing facets and displaced known direct support; negative small-sample mechanism check.

diagnostic.interpretation: On held-out challenges the known missing supports failed selection before token fitting; token truncation was not the cause for these supports.

limitations: Only six challenge questions in four semantic groups; held-out has two questions and three missing facets.
Single-agent labels; other candidates unjudged. Complete precision/recall and final answer accuracy are unmeasured.
All known missing-facet witnesses are one hop; this does not test a two-hop-only answer.
Two source-informed authoring batches plus baseline screening strongly enrich the set; 6/84 is not production prevalence.
Historical decision questions and synthetic absent-answer controls; not an estimate over representative live traffic.
No new graph edges, direct-retrieval settings, fusion, runtime selectors or default changes; shared layers/redundancy interactions not tested.

protocol.confirmation: Frozen labels, then baseline-only headroom verification, then dev sweep/immutable selection, then one held-out run of zero and selected arms.
protocol.latency: One debug assembly-plus-propagation timing per setting is not end-to-end release p50/p99; no adoption latency claim.
protocol.normalization: Nonnegative sum-one seeds, two-hop accumulation; per-arm/query graph-only max normalization then gain.
protocol.selection: max primary metric on declared dev family; ties: overall known-facet coverage, overall known-answer hit@10, lower gain, damping nearest .5
